gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Tight and sharp, Expose sets its letters shoulder to shoulder, while Noto Sans Rejang opens its lowercase into wide, glassy portholes. Over a long page, that body text keeps breathing easily.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-runic: Striking, Expose packs its letters with barely a pause between them. Noto Sans Runic sits beneath with a big x-height and curves left open, so the dense headline and the generous text feel like two different speeds.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Samaritan, whose hefty lowercase holds plenty of daylight inside its curves under Expose's compressed, refined heading. Warmth against polish.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase around them, and its counters stay connected to the outside. Expose, by contrast, runs tight and refined, so a long passage in the body moves along smoothly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-sc: Compressed and striking, Expose crowds its capitals almost level with the lowercase, while Noto Sans SC keeps chalky curves that stop short of closing. One is made for showing off; the other for getting on with it.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada reads bulky and unfussy, its c forms staying open instead of curling into rings. Expose is best at the refined, striking opener; the body font handles everything after.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Expose arrives striking and compressed, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase beside them. Noto Sans Siddham brings a large central band and an s with ends hanging far from the spine, so it can be sized up for comfort.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, its curve endings keeping well apart. Beneath Expose's tight heading, a long passage reads with a steady, professional hum.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Expose squeezes its capitals nearly level with the lowercase. Noto Sans Soyombo follows with a sizable x-height and curved letters whose wide mouths stay unclosed, so a long stretch on screen reads with real ease.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese reads clean and neutral, its e crossbars leaving open mouths and its capitals sitting close to the lowercase height. Expose earns its keep big and short, where its compressed polish can strike.
